answer: Trust each identity only for what it has actually delivered, and weigh every future role by that record: a newcomer is confined to the wharf of unproven work until it completes five audited jobs, and only then docks at the oasis where rewards flow. Each completed job leaves a signed plume of evidence in the public ledger, so a farm spinning up a thousand fresh names still finds every one stuck at the wharf, forced to do a thousand real jobs before earning. The record is replayed at settlement, and no spawned key can shortcut a history that does not exist.
